facts.fact: Wavemaker works from 21 storyboard presets, which the vendor says gives video pacing and shot structure an intentional feel.
facts.quote: Wavemaker works from 21 storyboard presets, so the pacing and shot structure feel intentional instead of random.

facts.fact: According to the page, Wavemaker's custom voice design is available on paid plans.
facts.quote: On paid plans you can design a custom voice to match a brand or a channel's personality.

facts.fact: The page says finished-video tools typically produce a complete video from text in a few minutes.
facts.quote: and hands you a video, usually in a few minutes.

facts.fact: The page names Pictory and Lumen5 as examples of stock-slideshow tools that pair text with generic stock footage.
facts.quote: like Pictory and Lumen5. They take your text and pair it with generic stock footage from a library

facts.fact: The page says Wavemaker accepts a prompt, a topic to research, a URL, documents, images, or existing video, and all of these feed the same pipeline.
facts.quote: a prompt, a topic to research, a URL, documents, images, or existing video all feed the same pipeline.

facts.fact: Per the vendor, a 30-second video costs about 75 credits to generate.
facts.quote: 30 seconds runs about 75 credits, 60 seconds runs 150

facts.fact: Per the vendor, a refine pass (chat-based edit) costs around 15 credits, a fraction of a full generation.
facts.quote: A refine pass costs a fraction of a full generation, around 15 credits, so iterating is cheap.

facts.fact: Per the vendor, the free plan gives users 75 credits, enough for a first video.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 75 credits, enough for your first video, at 480p with a watermark.

facts.fact: Per the vendor, the free plan exports at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: The free plan exports at 480p with a watermark, perfect for learning what good prompts feel like.

facts.fact: Per the vendor, paid plans start at $29 per month and remove the watermark, with exports up to 4K.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $29/mo for more credits, higher resolution up to 4K, and no watermark.

facts.fact: Per the vendor, a finished Wavemaker video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks through Adwave, starting from $50.
facts.quote: a finished Wavemaker video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks, from $50

facts.fact: Per the vendor, most videos are returned within two to five minutes after text is submitted.
facts.quote: Most videos come back in two to five minutes after you submit your text.

facts.fact: Per the vendor, its text-to-video pipeline has six stages.
facts.quote: They all feed the same six-stage pipeline, so the finished result feels consistent no matter where you started.

facts.fact: Per the vendor's checklist, a strong text prompt should list 2 to 4 key points as plain bullets.
facts.quote: list **2 to 4 key points** as plain bullets, state the **call to action**

facts.fact: Per the vendor, 16:9 is recommended for YouTube and web, 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, and 1:1 or 4:5 for feeds.
facts.quote: 16:9 for YouTube and web, 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, 1:1 or 4:5 for feeds

facts.fact: Per the vendor, a 30-second explainer prompt can specify length, tone, key points, call to action, and aspect ratio; the example prompt requests 9:16 for Instagram.
facts.quote: A 30-second explainer for a small-batch coffee roaster. Warm tone. ... 9:16 for Instagram.
